description: Import & Export Control Dept. - Order under Imports & Exports (Control) Act. that Inserting items to Special Import License Regulations Gaz. Ex> Ord. No. 1813/14 of 05.06.2013
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of new regulations under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, which constitutes legal/regulatory matters. While it mentions Minister Malik Samarawickrama, it does not describe his detailed portfolio responsibilities or make personnel changes - it simply identifies him as the authority issuing these regulatory changes. The core content focuses on legal amendments to import control regulations, specifically modifying H.S. codes and descriptions for special purpose motor vehicles, which falls squarely under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements.
